mapper.sql: B.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, B.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, B.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, B.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, C.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, B.LMT_PAGE_CNT AS lmtPageCnt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B JOIN TB_PRP_TMMBR M ON M.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD ORDER BY B.PBANC_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD WHERE B.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET LMT_PAGE_CNT = #{lmtPageCnt} WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
